test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II ( JSO ) 2021 Official Paper ( Held On: 10 August 2022 )
subject: general
question:
If P (A) = 0.4; P(B|A) = 0.05; P(C|A) = 0.04; P(B|A ∩ C) = 0.09; P(C|A ∩ B) = 0.07,

then the probability of occurrence of all events equals to:
solution:
**Formula used:**

P(A|B) = P(A ∩ B)/P(B)

**Calculation:**

P(A ∩ B ∩ C) = P(A) × P(B|A) × P(C|A ∩ B)

⇒ P(A ∩ B ∩ C) = 0.4 × 0.05 × 0.07

⇒ P(A ∩ B ∩ C) = 0.0014

**∴ The correct answer is option(1).**
